answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity must continuously prove its worth by contributing verifiable, non-replicable work. An attacker's clones blaze briefly like a comet — bright but fleeting — emitting no lasting signal. Genuine standing grows like a reef: layer upon layer of verified work, epoch after epoch. Each layer must pass independent verification before the next is added. An identity's weight is the sum of its verified layers; a sybil farm cannot outpace the compounding cost of faking them, because each fake layer must survive the same gauntlet. Cost scales with depth, not breadth.
